note: Single source of truth for AAA Handyman Services LLC coverage. Consumed by the browser service-area checker (/js/service-area-checker.js), the booking widget (/js/booking-widget.js), the booking page (/js/book-page.js), and the city landing-page generator (scripts/build-city-pages.mjs). Zone A = $100 minimum service call (within ~20 miles of Waterford). Zone B = $145 minimum service call (extended county / 20+ miles).
routeNote: Standing route days. One van covers the county, so each cluster of cities is worked on fixed days to keep drive time between jobs short. `days` uses JavaScript day numbers (0 = Sunday). Booking outside a city's route day is still accepted -- it is a preference, not a restriction -- but on-route days confirm fastest.

north-lakes.label: North & Lakes Route
north-lakes.blurb: Our home-base loop through the Waterford lakes area and up into Clarkston, Lake Orion, and Oxford.

west-corridor.label: West Corridor Route
west-corridor.blurb: The western run down Orchard Lake and Farmington roads through West Bloomfield, Novi, and Southfield.

east-metro.blurb: The eastern loop covering Troy and Rochester Hills down through Birmingham, Royal Oak, and the Villages.
